findings.text: Global address sizing helper fills cache line and physical virtual and cache width members of a processor descriptor for use by early identification code.

When identification capability is missing or extended level below the large extended leaf threshold, sizing uses build dependent defaults with 64 bit builds taking wide line plus 36 physical and 48 virtual widths and 32 bit builds taking narrow line plus 32 widths extended to 36 physical when large paging features are present.

When extended level is sufficient, virtual width comes from the middle byte of the extended leaf result and physical width from the low byte, an unset line size gains a modest default, then cache width mirrors physical width and cache alignment mirrors line size.

Legacy path without identification support distinguishes 486 from 386 by mutability of the alignment check flag, then iterates registered vendor handlers invoking each probe until a vendor string becomes present, then resolves vendor identity and stops.

Whitelist immunity positions are speculation zero, meltdown one, store bypass two, L1 terminal fault three, microarchitectural sampling four, MSBDS only five, swapgs six, ITLB multihit seven, Spectre variant two eight, MMIO nine, enhanced branch PBRSB ten, branch history eleven.

Affected issue positions are synchronous buffer zero, MMIO one, shared buffer two, return bleed three, SMT return stack four, speculative return five, gather six, register file seven, indirect target eight, indirect native only nine, transient scheduler ten, virtualization escape eleven.
Boot read only table pairs vendor family model matchers with immunity masks built by generic and Intel versioned and AMD family and Hygon family helpers, closed by an empty terminator entry.

Second boot read only table pairs matchers with affected masks, with Intel versioned entries bounded by stepping ranges and AMD plus Hygon entries covering whole families, also closed by an empty terminator entry.

Whitelist hit denotes exemption from named exposures while blacklist hit denotes susceptibility to named exposures; AMD generic family entry must remain after specific family entries or the specific entries become unreachable.
Table test succeeds only when the current processor matches an entry and that entry stored mask overlaps the queried mask.
MMIO immunity holds only when three fill buffer plus primary plus secondary stale data absence indications are all asserted together.

Register file susceptibility is denied by its immunity indication, forced by its clear indication for virtualized migration, otherwise needs blacklist membership, with models 0x97 and 0xB7 excused when current type is not Atom and hybrid feature is absent.
Indirect target susceptibility needs missing immunity indication plus Intel vendor plus absent branch history control, and then either virtualized execution or blacklist membership.

Staleness test passes unknown processors with an informational note for Intel, passes virtualized execution because host values are inflated, treats debug high version bit as stale, otherwise compares current version against tabulated minimum.

Central boot bug setup combines whitelist absence with capability negatives and feature presence to decide store, sampling, transactional, shared buffer, MMIO, swap, Spectre and enhanced branch marks, with fully speculation exempt processors stopping after microcode warning plus taint and ITLB handling while others always gain Spectre V1.

Same setup decides return prediction, transient scheduler, gather, register file, branch history, indirect target with native refinement, virtual escape, meltdown and L1 fault marks from blacklist hits with capability, vector, vendor and virtualization gates, where meltdown is evaluated late and L1 fault only when meltdown is not exempted.
Long nop support is cleared on 32 bit builds and forced on other builds.

Comma separated control input is split into tokens with numeric tokens forcing capability indices directly when inside total range and named tokens searched across feature then bug name tables with warning on unknown, and the routine reports whether any force occurred.
Boot initialization entry establishes processor vulnerability marks before mitigation selection.
Placing a generic family matcher before specific family matchers would shadow the specific entries and misclassify exemption, so table order is safety critical.
Forced capability and bug flag changes taint execution and can contradict hardware enumeration, risking disabled protections or enabled unsupported paths.
Trusting hypervisor microcode versions would misjudge freshness because hosts inflate values, so virtualized execution bypasses staleness comparison.
